title: Findings ledger event (v1)
description: One JSON object per line of an append-only, repo-local ledger (default `.style-findings.jsonl` at the main worktree root). Three event kinds share the file: `finding` (something was flagged), `outcome` (what became of it), `gate_pass` (an automated gate passed over these files). The current state of a finding is the fold of its events in file order: it is open until an `outcome` for its id appears; a later `finding` with the same id after an outcome re-opens it (gate source only; l1/l2 re-adds are ignored). `rule_id` is one of: a clause id defined in the repo's configured rules files, `unmapped`, or `<tool>:<code>` (for example `ruff:F811`). This schema only checks the shape of a rule id; whether a clause exists is checked against the rules files when an event is written, not when old events are read. IDs: l1/l2 -> `<repo>:<source>:<run_id>:<display_id>`; gate -> `<repo>:gate:<sha1 of file|rule_code|whitespace-stripped line text, first 12 hex>`, so repeats of one issue fold into one finding (gate events carry run_id `gate` and a display_id equal to the 12-hex hash). `ts` is local time without a timezone. Fields added after the first v1 ledgers (`discovered_at`, `also_matches`, `rule_id_source`) are optional, and every line of an older v1 ledger still validates.

rule_id.description: A clause id from the configured rules files (for example P0E.2, R.7), `unmapped`, or `<tool>:<code>` (for example ruff:F811).

display_id.description: Short handle for humans; the value to put in a `Fixes-Finding:` commit trailer.

ts.description: When the event was written to the ledger.

rule_code.description: What the detector called it: a tool code, a gate code, or the category text a reviewer gave.

category.description: Free-form grouping label. Older ledgers use a fixed set (exception, fallback, complexity, ...); new events carry the clause family (P0E), the tool name (ruff) or `unmapped`.

snippet.description: Optional code context captured when the finding was recorded.

discovered_at.description: Optional. When the reviewer produced the finding, if that differs from `ts` (the ledger write time).

also_matches.description: Optional. Other findings on the same file and line that were collapsed into this one (this event is the most severe).

rule_id_source.description: Optional. Where the rule_id came from: a model's category, a human, a tool code mapped through tool_rule_map, or a later attribution step. Absent on older events.
